tasks.q: Which question matters most for choosing storage for a video camera?
a: How portable and durable does it need to be?
tasks.fb: A camera is carried, knocked and used away from mains power.

tasks.q: A customer needs 12 TB for a backup server on a tight budget. What matters most?
tasks.fb: They aren't carrying it, so bulk and price win.

tasks.q: Which storage is most suitable for selling a film in shops?
a: Optical disc, such as Blu-ray: cheap to mass produce and easy to post
Solid state drives, one per customer
tasks.fb: Cost per copy is what matters here.

tasks.q: Why is read-only acceptable for this?
a: Customers only need to watch the film, not write to the disc
Because it makes the film shorter
tasks.fb: No write capability keeps the cost down.

tasks.q: Which device suits carrying work between home and an office?
a: A USB flash drive: small, portable and durable
A CD-ROM that can't be written to
tasks.fb: Solid state, portable and plugs in anywhere.

tasks.q: Which characteristic is least important here?
tasks.fb: Documents are small; the device just has to survive the journey.

tasks.q: Match each situation to the most suitable storage.
pairs: Solid state: small, light, survives movement
Solid state memory card: fast writes and portable
Optical disc: cheap to mass produce
Magnetic hard disks: large capacity at low cost
tasks.fb: All four appear in your lesson's scenario list.

tasks.q: Why do schools use magnetic hard disks for bulk network storage?
a: They give the most gigabytes for the money and never leave the server room
tasks.fb: Capacity and cost outweigh speed here.

tasks.q: Why is an SSD used for a computer's operating system?
a: It loads and responds much faster than a hard disk
tasks.fb: Boot time is where SSDs shine.

tasks.q: A company archives 200 TB of training videos it rarely opens. Which is most suitable?
a: Magnetic tape: enormous capacity at the lowest cost
tasks.fb: Slow access doesn't matter for an archive.

tasks.q: Why should a photo backup be kept in a different place from the originals?
a: A fire, flood or theft could destroy both copies at once
tasks.fb: Off-site is the point of a backup.

tasks.q: Which type of storage is most suitable for each situation?
items: Transferring work between home and an office
Storing tracks on an MP3 player
Main storage for a school network
Storing video on a video camera
Distributing a video game for a console
tasks.fb: In the exam, always name the characteristic that makes it suitable.

info.title: Downloads changed things
info.text: Games and films increasingly arrive as downloads, so optical drives are vanishing from computers and consoles.

info.title: Cloud is still disks
info.text: Cloud storage is someone else's secondary storage: racks of hard disks and SSDs in a data centre.

info.title: Cameras and cards
info.text: Professional cameras use fast memory cards because 4K video writes hundreds of megabytes every second.

info.title: Write once
info.text: Archives sometimes use write-once media on purpose, so records can't be altered later.

info.title: The 3-2-1 rule
info.text: Three copies, on two types of media, with one off-site. It's the standard advice for backups.

info.title: Hybrid drives
info.text: Some drives combine a small SSD with a large hard disk, using the fast part for the files you use most.
